global_transport_rules: Only exact 127.0.0.1 origin selected by the current run is supported in Beta 1.0; no wildcard/LAN binding.
LLD-12 middleware validates Host/origin/session/anti-forgery requirements before mutation handlers run.
Request bodies use explicit Content-Type application/json and bounded byte limits supplied by the owning route/LLD; unknown fields follow the route contract rather than being silently persisted.
Transport validation produces value objects; Starlette Request/Response objects do not cross into domain/foundation application services.
All errors use errors.json stable code contract; raw framework/database exceptions are mapped internally.
No foundation route exposes arbitrary SQL, filesystem path mutation, migration repair, audit deletion/update, or job-state forcing.
Domain API routes are owned by their domain/UI LLD packets and reuse LLD-01 application boundary/UoW/error conventions rather than importing these route handlers.
